prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: a woven wool carpet: deep red field with a small repeating gold and cream geometric motif (diamonds), fine weave texture. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: woven wool carpet, deep red field with SMALL regularly repeating gold and cream geometric diamond motifs. Fine woven texture rendered as intentional pixel clusters, not noisy pixels. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art. Strict uniform square hard-edged pixels, consistent pixel grid throughout, no antialias, blur, soft brushes, photographic textures, stochastic noise, or checkerboard dithering. Small crisp clusters 3–10 pixels. Rich earthy worn palette, 4–6 shades per material; reddish purple saturated shadows and warm yellow highlights. Orthographic overhead view; flat even neutral soft upper-left illumination, no cast shadows, glow, vignette or dark lighting. Perfect periodic pattern with edges matching horizontally and vertically: left edge continues exactly at right edge, top continues at bottom. Carpet alone fills entire image edge to edge; no borders, frames, objects, text or focal points. Square output.
